notes.text: Life-threatening acute asthma: give salbutamol by continuous nebulisation, with oxygen driving the nebuliser (piped oxygen or a cylinder with a high-flow regulator, 6 L/min). Ipratropium is added to the nebulised solution. Arrange immediate transfer to a higher level of care, notify senior staff, and reassess immediately after starting salbutamol.
Ward rule in the tutorial's doctor's notes: only give salbutamol hourly on the ward. If more is needed, get an ICU review.

Drug classes on the NAC Asthma & COPD Medications chart: salbutamol (Ventolin, Airomir) is a SABA reliever; ipratropium (Atrovent) is a SAMA. pMDIs should be used with a spacer (and a face mask if needed).
